The '''Melusi Uprising''' was a part of the [[Unification Campaigns]] that took place in the [[900s BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The conflict shared its name with the [[Melus system/Legends|Melus system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Nicandra sector/Legends|Nicandra sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> and saw the participation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]]. Members of that organization fought gallantly during a [[Confrontation on Korvaii|surface confrontation]] on<ref name="EGTW" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="ChildOfLight">"[[Child of Light]]"</ref> [[Korvaii]]<ref name="EGTW" />&mdash;a part of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Korvaii system/Legends|same name]] in the Mid Rim's [[Kordu sector/Legends|Kordu sector]]<ref name="EAOC" />&mdash;which ended the uprising.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Melusi Uprising was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
